claims.text: Aurora Avenue North had 35 injury crashes in police records since 2021-10-31: 1 person killed.
At the U.S. DOT's values that harm costs about $2.4 million a year.
No crash pattern here stands out against the city's worst crash locations.

The city's Leading Pedestrian Interval signals: worked (pedestrian injury crashes changed -33% (95% interval -52% to -13%) at 371 sites against sites treated later or the citywide trend, and a placebo date shows nothing); a second run of the same design on 366 sites agrees.
Lighting would avoid about 0.7 crashes a year (CMF 11027, the median of 2 eligible records), worth $255,000 a year.
Pavement Friction Management would avoid about 0.6 crashes a year (CMF 195, the only eligible record), worth $211,000 a year.
The state transportation department (route designation only; confirm ownership) is responsible for Aurora Avenue North (signed route in OpenStreetMap; owner not confirmed).
A request letter to the state transportation department (route designation only; confirm ownership) is ready to draft from these facts.
